project_name: Delhi-Meerut Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) Project
submission_summary: Requestor(s): Two requestors (including 19 co-signaturies). Issues raised: The requestors alleged lack of disclosure of information and documents; lack of transparency and rationale about selection of the track alignment; harmful impacts on mental health of residents and disruption of utility services.
remarks: Date received: Feb. 14, 2024 Date acknowledged: Feb. 20, 2024 Determination of eligibility: Feb. 20, 2024 Eligibility Assessment: Ineligible. The project is cofinanced with the Asian Development Bank (ADB). As per the cofinancing framework agreement between ADB and AIIB, ADB’s Safeguards Policy Statement (SPS) is the applicable environmental and social policy on this project. Furthermore, ADB’s Accountability Mechanism is responsible for handling all complaints relating to E&S issues that may arise under the project. Consequently, in accordance with AIIB’s Policy on PPM, this submission is not eligible for consideration by the PPM.
